title: Agent Management
subtitle: Create and manage AI agents, configure roles, abilities and models

assistant.name: General Assistant
assistant.description: A general AI assistant that can answer various questions
assistant.goal: Help users complete various tasks and answer their questions
assistant.backstory: I am an intelligent assistant, skilled at understanding and answering various questions.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: A researcher agent skilled in research and analysis
researcher.goal: Conduct in-depth research on various topics and provide detailed analysis reports
researcher.backstory: I am a professional researcher, skilled at collecting and analyzing information.

coder.name: Programmer
coder.description: A programmer agent skilled in coding and code review
coder.goal: Write high-quality code and solve technical problems
coder.backstory: I am an experienced programmer, proficient in multiple programming languages.

empty: No agents yet, click the button above to create

basic.name: Имя агента
basic.nameHint: Задайте легко узнаваемое имя для агента
basic.goalHint: Опишите основную цель и задачи агента
basic.backstoryHint: Задайте предысторию агента для усиления его характера

abilities.toolsHint: Выберите инструменты, которые агент может использовать
abilities.knowledgeBasesHint: Выберите базы знаний, к которым агент имеет доступ

model.providerHint: Выберите провайдера языковой модели для агента
model.temperatureHint: Управление случайностью вывода, 0 — детерминированный, 1 — максимальная случайность
model.maxTokensHint: Ограничение максимального количества токенов на ответ
model.topPHint: Управление разнообразием вывода, 0.1 — учитывать только 10% наиболее вероятных токенов

advanced.planningHint: Позволить агенту автоматически планировать шаги задачи
advanced.maxMessagesHint: Максимальное количество сообщений для хранения в памяти
advanced.maxRetriesHint: Максимальное количество повторных попыток при ошибке задачи

delete.title: Delete Agent
delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete agent "{name}"?

import.title: Import Agents
import.hint: Support importing JSON format agent definition files

reset.title: Reset Agent
reset.confirm: Are you sure you want to reset {name} to its initial state?
reset.warning: After reset, the agent's role, goal, backstory and tool configuration will be restored to system defaults. Your custom modifications will be lost.

expert.batchLlmHint: This will set the LLM provider and model for all created expert agents.
expert.noExperts: No expert agents yet. They will be auto-initialized on system startup.
